# ContractIQ — Engineering Document

**Status:** Draft for review (Stage 1 of 7)
**Source:** `docs/ContractIQ_PRD.md` v1.0 (2026-06-24)
**Generated by:** `skills/engineering-planner/SKILL.md`

> This document is the authoritative architecture reference. No implementation
> begins until it is approved. Every later stage (`/implementation-specs`,
> `/frontend-setup`, `/security-foundation`) reads from this document.

### Architecture decisions that override or resolve PRD ambiguity

The PRD describes a plain React SPA with an unspecified backend ("Supabase Edge
Functions or hosted Node.js API") and assumes Netlify hosting. This project's
`skills/engineering-planner/SKILL.md` fixes the frontend to **Next.js**, which
changes those downstream choices. The following are deliberate, resolved
decisions — not open questions:

| Area | PRD assumption | Resolved decision | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Frontend | Plain React SPA | Next.js 14, App Router, TypeScript | Fixed by the engineering-planner skill |
| Backend | "Edge Functions or Node API" (ambiguous) | Next.js Route Handlers (`app/api/**/route.ts`) only | Single deployable, no second runtime/service to operate |
| Hosting | Netlify | Netlify (confirmed, matches PRD) | PRD's own cost assumptions and this project's deployment lab both target Netlify; an earlier draft of this doc considered Vercel before that was confirmed |
| Chat delivery | Supabase Realtime (PRD §6 component list) | Direct HTTP streaming (`ReadableStream`) from a Route Handler | Simpler, no DB write amplification; full history is persisted either way |
| LLM | OpenAI GPT-4o | OpenAI GPT-4o (unchanged) | PRD is explicit and detailed here; note `README.md`'s mention of "Anthropic Claude API" is stale boilerplate and is superseded by the PRD |
| Auth / DB / Storage | Supabase | Supabase (unchanged) | PRD is explicit here |

---

## 1. Executive Summary

**Project:** ContractIQ — an AI-powered contract review tool for NDAs and MSAs.

**Business goal:** Let SMB founders, ops leads, and freelancers understand what
they're signing without paying $250–500/hr for lawyer review. Reduce contract
review time from 90–120 minutes to ≤15 minutes.

**Problem statement:** SMBs and freelancers sign NDAs and MSAs with no in-house
legal counsel. Generic AI chat tools give unstructured summaries with no page
reference, no confidence score, and no way to add custom terms. ContractIQ
wraps GPT-4o in a structured, auditable workflow: extract the 20–30 terms that
actually matter per contract type, attribute each to a page, score confidence,
and let the user ask follow-up questions grounded strictly in the uploaded
document.

**Target users:**
- **Primary:** Time-pressed founder/ops lead at a 5–250 person company with no
  legal team, signing 5–15 NDAs/MSAs per month.
- **Secondary:** Freelancer/consultant receiving 1–4 MSAs per month from larger
  clients, unable to afford legal review.

**Success criteria (from PRD §3):**
| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| North Star: upload → completed review time | ≤15 min (baseline 90 min) |
| Key-term extraction F1 | ≥88% NDA / ≥85% MSA |
| Time to first key-term display | ≤30s P95 (≤20 pages) |
| Confidence calibration error | ≤0.10 |
| 30-day retention | ≥45% |
| Cost per contract analysis | ≤$0.25 |

## 2. Product Scope

### In scope (MVP, v0.1–v1.0)
- Email/password auth (Supabase Auth)
- PDF upload (≤10MB, ≤20 pages, text-layer only) with contract-type selection (NDA/MSA)
- Server-side text extraction with page markers, stored once, reused for both extraction and chat
- GPT-4o structured key-term extraction with confidence scoring and source-sentence attribution
- Custom key-term addition (≤5 per contract) before processing
- Key-terms panel (term, value, page, confidence, colour-coded)
- Inline PDF viewer (PDF.js) with click-to-navigate page references, and a text-viewer fallback when Storage is unavailable
- Inline correction of extracted terms, with original AI value retained
- Contract chat: streamed, document-grounded Q&A with mandatory page citation, persistent per-contract history
- Dashboard with contract history, sortable
- Feedback (thumbs up/down + comment) per contract
- Security audit, WCAG 2.1 AA, rate limiting, onboarding tooltips (v1.0)

### Out of scope (deferred)
- **Phase 2 (v1.1):** CSV/PDF export of key terms, batch upload (≤5 contracts), dashboard analytics
- **Phase 3 (v1.2):** OCR for scanned PDFs, contract comparison view, email notifications, multi-user team workspaces
- Contract types other than NDA/MSA
- Non-English contracts, non-US/UK legal conventions
- Fine-tuned extraction model (few-shot only at MVP)
- Chunked/vector RAG for chat (full-context only, ≤15k tokens)

### Future enhancements (explicitly named in PRD, not committed)
- Fine-tuned model if few-shot F1 falls short of target
- Claude/Gemini fallback if OpenAI pricing or availability degrades
- Legal SME partnership for expanded ground-truth labelling

## 3. User Personas

| Persona | Role | Company size | Behaviour | Pain today | Permissions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **The Time-Pressed Founder/Ops Lead** (primary) | Founder, COO, Procurement Manager, Legal Ops Manager | 5–250 employees, no in-house legal | Signs 5–15 NDAs/MSAs/month | 90–120 min/contract; misses auto-renewal, indemnification, IP clauses; pays $250–500/hr for ad-hoc legal review | Standard authenticated user — full access to own contracts only |
| **The Freelancer/Consultant** (secondary) | Individual contributor (design, marketing, dev, consulting) | N/A (solo) | Receives 1–4 MSAs/month from larger clients | Can't afford legal review; signs without pushback due to power imbalance; no page-level reference with confidence scores | Standard authenticated user — identical permissions to primary persona |

There is a **single role** at MVP: authenticated user, own-data-only via RLS.
No admin, reviewer, or team-member roles exist yet — multi-user team
workspaces are an explicit v1.2 feature and are out of scope for this
document's schema/API design.

## 4. User Flows

### 4.1 Signup / Login

```
User Action:          Clicks "Sign Up" on landing page, enters email + password
Frontend Behavior:    Client form validation; submits to POST /api/auth/signup
Backend Processing:   Route Handler calls supabase.auth.signUp() via server client,
                       sets session cookies (@supabase/ssr)
Database Interaction: INSERT auth.users (Supabase-managed) → trigger creates
                       a matching profiles row
System Response:      Verification email sent; on verified login, redirect to
                       /dashboard showing empty state: "No contracts reviewed
                       yet — upload your first contract to begin."
```

### 4.2 Contract upload + pre-processing

```
User Action:          Selects contract type (NDA/MSA), drags/drops or picks a PDF
Frontend Behavior:    Client-side size/type pre-check; multipart POST to
                       /api/contracts/upload
Backend Processing:   Validates MIME/size/page-count; runs pdf-parse; builds
                       [PAGE N]-marked text; attempts non-blocking Storage upload
Database Interaction: INSERT contracts (status='uploaded', contract_text,
                       file_path if Storage succeeded)
System Response:      Returns standard term-list preview for the chosen type;
                       UI shows "+ Add Key Term" (≤5) before the user triggers
                       processing
```

### 4.3 Key-term extraction

```
User Action:          Clicks "Process Contract"
Frontend Behavior:    POST /api/contracts/:id/process; shows 3-step progress
                       indicator (extracting → analysing → compiling), polled
                       via TanStack Query refetchInterval
Backend Processing:   Reads contract_text + custom_key_terms; calls GPT-4o
                       (json_object, temp 0.1, few-shot); validates/retries JSON
Database Interaction: INSERT extracted_key_terms[]; UPDATE contracts
                       SET status='completed', processed_at=now()
System Response:      Results page renders: left = PDF/text viewer, right =
                       key-terms panel, colour-coded by confidence
                       (green ≥80 / amber 50–79 / red <50)
```

### 4.4 Chat with contract

```
User Action:          Types a question in the "Chat with Contract" panel
Frontend Behavior:    POST /api/contracts/:id/chat; renders streamed tokens
                       live via useChatStream hook
Backend Processing:   Verifies ownership + status='completed'; classifies query
                       (contract/history/both) via regex heuristic; fetches
                       ≤200 prior messages; calls GPT-4o with stream:true and a
                       document-only grounding system prompt
Database Interaction: INSERT chat_messages (role='user') immediately on send;
                       INSERT chat_messages (role='assistant', page_citation)
                       once the stream completes
System Response:      Answer streams into the chat UI; "[Page X]" renders as a
                       clickable citation that scrolls the PDF/text viewer
```

### 4.5 Dashboard

```
User Action:          Navigates to /dashboard
Frontend Behavior:    TanStack Query fetches summary + paginated list
Backend Processing:   GET /api/dashboard/summary, GET /api/contracts?sort=...
Database Interaction: SELECT aggregates + paginated contracts, scoped by RLS
                       to auth.uid()
System Response:      Summary cards (total, by type, last 5) + sortable table;
                       row click opens /contracts/:id
```

### 4.6 Inline correction

```
User Action:          Clicks an extracted term's value, edits it inline
Frontend Behavior:    PATCH /api/contracts/:id/terms/:termId { value }
Backend Processing:   Validates ownership; on first edit, copies current value
                       into original_ai_value before overwriting
Database Interaction: UPDATE extracted_key_terms SET value, is_edited=true,
                       edited_at=now()
System Response:      "Edited" badge appears within 2s; change is visible in
                       the term_corrections view for monitoring
```

### 4.7 Feedback

```
User Action:          Clicks thumbs up/down (+ optional comment) on results page
Frontend Behavior:    POST /api/contracts/:id/feedback
Backend Processing:   Validates rating enum + comment length (≤2000 chars)
Database Interaction: UPSERT user_feedback ON CONFLICT (contract_id, user_id)
System Response:      "Thanks for your feedback" toast
```

## 5. Frontend Architecture

**Stack:** Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (styled per
`docs/design.md` via the `design-system` skill — applied in Stage 4, not this
document).

**State management:** **TanStack Query** for all server state — contracts
list/detail, dashboard summary, chat history. Rationale: built-in caching and
de-dupe, mutation-driven cache invalidation (needed after inline edits,
custom-term add/remove, feedback submit), and native polling (`refetchInterval`
while `contract.status === 'processing'`) that drives the 3-step progress
indicator without a websocket.

Chat streaming does not need a second state library: a `useChatStream` hook
performs the `fetch()` + `ReadableStream` read inside a TanStack `useMutation`,
accumulating chunks in local component state for live rendering, then merges
the final message into the cached chat history via `queryClient.setQueryData`
on completion.

PDF-viewer state (current page, zoom) and the key-terms-panel ↔ viewer link
(FR-07) are **local UI state**, not server state — lifted into
`app/(app)/contracts/[id]/page.tsx` and shared via a small
`ContractViewerContext` so a term-row click sets `targetPage` and both
`PdfViewer` and `TextViewerFallback` react identically (satisfying FR-06's
requirement that both viewers respond to the same page-target prop).

**Required UX states:**
- **Loading:** skeletons for dashboard/results; 3-step processing indicator during extraction
- **Empty:** dashboard ("no contracts yet"), chat ("ask your first question")
- **Error:** upload rejection reasons (size/type/page-count/scanned-PDF), OpenAI failure + retry CTA, Storage-down banner (hides only the PDF viewer, text fallback still works per FR-06)
- **Low-confidence warning:** non-dismissible ⚠️ tooltip on any term <50% confidence — never hidden
- **Responsive:** mobile warning banner (PRD constraint — app is usable but not optimized for mobile at MVP)
- **Accessibility:** WCAG 2.1 AA — keyboard navigation and visible focus states on every interactive element, per the `design-system` skill's hard rules

**Page / component hierarchy:**
```
app/
├── page.tsx                        Landing (public)
├── (auth)/{login,signup,reset-password}/page.tsx
└── (app)/
    ├── dashboard/page.tsx           SummaryCards + ContractTable
    ├── contracts/
    │   ├── upload/page.tsx         UploadForm (type selector, dropzone, term preview)
    │   └── [id]/page.tsx           PdfViewer | TextViewerFallback  +  KeyTermsPanel  +  ChatPanel
    └── settings/page.tsx           Profile, data deletion, disclaimer
```

## 6. Backend Architecture

**Stack:** Next.js Route Handlers (`app/api/**/route.ts`) running on Netlify
via its Next.js runtime adapter. This is the *only* backend — there is no separate Supabase Edge Functions
service or standalone Node API. Each route is a thin orchestration layer: no
business logic lives in the frontend beyond optimistic UI state.

**Core systems:**
- **Auth:** Supabase Auth (email/password). Session cookies set server-side
  (`@supabase/ssr`) via dedicated `/api/auth/{signup,login,logout}` routes so
  cookie handling is consistent between client and server reads. `middleware.ts`
  protects `/dashboard`, `/contracts`, `/chat`, `/settings` — unauthenticated
  requests redirect to `/login`.
- **Authorization:** every resource-scoped route re-verifies `user_id` ownership
  server-side in addition to relying on Postgres RLS (defense in depth) —
  returns `404` (not `403`) on mismatch to avoid leaking resource existence.
- **Validation:** Zod schemas per route, rejecting with `422` and a structured
  error body before any DB or OpenAI call is made.
- **Error handling:** consistent error contract across all routes —

  | Status | Meaning |
  |---|---|
  | 401 | No valid session |
  | 404 | Resource not found or not owned |
  | 422 | Request validation failed |
  | 429 | Rate limited (`Retry-After` header) |
  | 502 | Upstream OpenAI failure after retries exhausted |

- **Middleware:** route-protection + session refresh; rate limiting is added in
  Stage 7 (`security-foundation`), not designed here.

**Service interaction diagram:**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Browser (Next.js Client Components)
  participant R as Next.js Route Handler (Netlify)
  participant S as Supabase (Postgres / Auth / Storage)
  participant O as OpenAI GPT-4o

  C->>R: POST /api/contracts/upload (PDF)
  R->>R: pdf-parse -> [PAGE N] text
  R->>S: INSERT contracts; Storage upload (non-blocking)
  R-->>C: contract_id + standard term preview

  C->>R: POST /api/contracts/:id/process
  R->>S: SELECT contract_text, custom_key_terms
  R->>O: chat.completions.create (json_object, temp 0.1)
  O-->>R: JSON term array
  R->>S: INSERT extracted_key_terms[]; UPDATE status=completed
  R-->>C: extracted terms

  C->>R: POST /api/contracts/:id/chat (stream)
  R->>S: SELECT contract_text, chat_messages (<=200)
  R->>O: stream:true completion
  O-->>R: token stream
  R-->>C: ReadableStream chunks
  R->>S: INSERT chat_messages (user + assistant)
```

## 7. Database Design and Schema

All user-owned tables carry their own `user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id)`
column (denormalized even where a join to a parent table would technically
suffice), so every RLS policy is a single-column `auth.uid() = user_id` check
with no subqueries or joins. `updated_at` is auto-maintained via a shared
`set_updated_at()` trigger function wherever the column exists.

### Enums

```sql
CREATE TYPE contract_type_enum   AS ENUM ('NDA', 'MSA');
CREATE TYPE contract_status_enum AS ENUM ('uploaded', 'processing', 'completed', 'error');
CREATE TYPE chat_role_enum       AS ENUM ('user', 'assistant');
CREATE TYPE feedback_rating_enum AS ENUM ('up', 'down');
```

### `profiles`
App-specific user metadata beyond `auth.users` — not an explicit PRD table,
but required to support onboarding-tooltip state (a named v1.0 requirement)
server-side instead of inventing ad-hoc client-only storage.

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK, REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| display_name | text | nullable |
| onboarding_completed_at | timestamptz | nullable |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |
| updated_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |

Populated via a `handle_new_user()` trigger on `auth.users` INSERT (standard
Supabase pattern). RLS: `auth.uid() = id` for SELECT/UPDATE; no DELETE policy
(cascades from `auth.users` deletion).

### `contracts`
Core entity — one row per uploaded contract. Backs FR-02, FR-03, FR-10, FR-13.

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() |
| user_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| original_filename | text | NOT NULL |
| contract_type | contract_type_enum | NOT NULL (user-selected at upload) |
| detected_contract_type | contract_type_enum | nullable — soft mismatch warning, see §Open Items |
| status | contract_status_enum | NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uploaded' |
| error_message | text | nullable |
| contract_text | text | nullable (populated synchronously at upload; `[PAGE N]` markers inline) |
| page_count | int | nullable, CHECK (page_count > 0 AND page_count <= 20) |
| file_size_bytes | bigint | NOT NULL, CHECK (file_size_bytes <= 10485760) |
| file_path | text | nullable — Storage object path; null if Storage upload failed (non-blocking per FR-06) |
| last_accessed_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() — drives 90-day retention sweep |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |
| updated_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |
| processed_at | timestamptz | nullable — set when status -> 'completed' |

Indexes: `(user_id, created_at DESC)` for dashboard sort; `(status)` for the
retention sweep and operational monitoring. RLS: own-data-only, all 4
operations.

### `custom_key_terms`
User-requested custom terms, added *before* processing (FR-05) — the request
itself, not the extracted value.

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() |
| contract_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| user_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| term_name | text | NOT NULL, CHECK (char_length(term_name) BETWEEN 2 AND 100) |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |

A `BEFORE INSERT` trigger (`enforce_max_custom_terms()`) rejects the 6th row
for a given `contract_id` (defense-in-depth behind the API-layer check in
§9). Index: `(contract_id)`. RLS: own-data-only.

### `extracted_key_terms`
The actual AI output — standard and custom terms share the same shape.

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() |
| contract_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| user_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| custom_key_term_id | uuid | nullable REFERENCES custom_key_terms(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |
| is_manual | boolean | NOT NULL DEFAULT false — true when sourced from custom_key_terms |
| term_name | text | NOT NULL |
| value | text | NOT NULL |
| page_number | int | NOT NULL, CHECK (page_number >= 1) |
| confidence_score | numeric(5,2) | NOT NULL, CHECK (confidence_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100) |
| source_sentence | text | NOT NULL |
| is_edited | boolean | NOT NULL DEFAULT false |
| original_ai_value | text | nullable — populated on first user edit only |
| edited_at | timestamptz | nullable |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |
| updated_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |

Indexes: `(contract_id)`; `(confidence_score)` for low-confidence
queries/monitoring. RLS: own-data-only.

### `term_corrections` (view, not a table)
PRD §8 explicitly names this a view, feeding the "trigger a prompt review if
correction rate exceeds 12%" monitoring process.

```sql
CREATE VIEW term_corrections WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  ekt.id               AS term_id,
  ekt.contract_id,
  ekt.user_id,
  c.contract_type,
  ekt.term_name,
  ekt.original_ai_value,
  ekt.value            AS corrected_value,
  ekt.confidence_score,
  ekt.edited_at
FROM extracted_key_terms ekt
JOIN contracts c ON c.id = ekt.contract_id
WHERE ekt.is_edited = true;
```

`security_invoker = true` makes the view respect the caller's own RLS — safe
if ever queried by an authenticated user, though in practice it's queried via
the Supabase dashboard/service role for the weekly drift check.

### `chat_sessions`
Wrapper for a contract's chat thread (US-012). One session per contract at MVP.

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() |
| contract_id | uuid | NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES contracts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| user_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |
| updated_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |

`UNIQUE(contract_id)` enforces 1:1 for MVP simplicity — the PRD never
describes multiple chat threads per contract. RLS: own-data-only.

### `chat_messages`
Backs FR-08, FR-09 — grounding, page citation, conversation memory (up to 200
messages).

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() |
| session_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| user_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| role | chat_role_enum | NOT NULL |
| content | text | NOT NULL, CHECK (char_length(content) <= 5000) |
| page_citation | int | nullable — parsed from `[Page X]` in assistant responses |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |

Index: `(session_id, created_at ASC)` — the exact access pattern for "fetch up
to 200 messages ascending". RLS: own-data-only.

### `user_feedback`
Backs FR-12, US-010.

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() |
| contract_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| user_id | uuid | NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| rating | feedback_rating_enum | NOT NULL |
| comment | text | nullable, CHECK (char_length(comment) <= 2000) |
| created_at | timestamptz | NOT NULL DEFAULT now() |

`UNIQUE (contract_id, user_id)` — one feedback record per contract per user;
the app performs `ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE` for resubmission. RLS:
own-data-only.

### Storage bucket

```sql
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
VALUES ('contracts', 'contracts', false, 10485760, ARRAY['application/pdf'])
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE POLICY "contracts_insert_own_folder" ON storage.objects
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'contracts' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);

CREATE POLICY "contracts_select_own_folder" ON storage.objects
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (bucket_id = 'contracts' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);

CREATE POLICY "contracts_delete_own_folder" ON storage.objects
  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (bucket_id = 'contracts' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);
```

Path convention (fixed by PRD FR-14): `contracts/{user_id}/{contract_id}/{filename}.pdf`.
`{contract_id}` must exist before the Storage upload — insert the `contracts`
row first (obtaining `id`), then attempt the Storage upload, then update
`file_path`.

### Reserved for Stage 7

`rate_limit_events` is owned by the `security-foundation` skill and is **not**
created by this document — reserving the name here to prevent a collision.

## 8. AI Architecture

**Provider:** OpenAI, model `gpt-4o`. Context window ≥128k tokens (a 20-page
contract is ~10–15k tokens, well within budget even with history).

### Extraction

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Response format | `{ type: "json_object" }` |
| Temperature | 0.1 |
| Max output tokens | 2000 |
| Latency budget | ≤20s P95 per call |
| Cost budget | ≤$0.20/analysis |

**Prompt composition:** contract-type-specific few-shot block (3 labelled NDA
*or* 3 labelled MSA examples, selected by `contract_type`) + the standard term
list for that type (10 for NDA / 12 for MSA, verbatim from PRD §4) + any rows
from `custom_key_terms` appended as additional target terms + the output JSON
schema instructions.

**Output schema** (validated server-side with Zod before any DB write):

```ts
z.array(z.object({
  term_name: z.string(),
  value: z.string(),
  page_number: z.number().int().min(1),
  confidence_score: z.number().min(0).max(1), // model outputs 0-1; ×100 before storing
  source_sentence: z.string(),
}))
```

**JSON-parse-failure retry:** exactly one retry using PRD §8's exact corrective
prompt ("Your previous response was not valid JSON. Return only the JSON
array, no explanation."). A second failure sets `contracts.status = 'error'`
with `error_message` populated — no partial rows are ever written (the insert
happens only after full validation succeeds).

**Custom terms:** zero-shot, same output schema, appended to the standard
list — no separate inference call.

**Confidence scoring:** embedded in the same extraction call (model
self-reports 0.0–1.0) — no second call, per PRD §8.

### Chat

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Temperature | 0.4 |
| Max output tokens | 1000 |
| Streaming | `stream: true` |
| Latency budget | ≤15s P95 end-to-end |

**Context assembly per turn:**
1. Full `contract_text` (≤15,000 tokens — no chunking/vector retrieval at MVP;
   deferred until length limits are raised post-v1.0 per PRD §7)
2. Full conversation history, ascending, up to 200 messages
3. System prompt enforcing: document-only grounding, "Based on the document…"
   framing, mandatory `[Page X]` citation, and "I cannot find this in the
   document" as a valid, expected answer — never a failure state

**Query classification (`contract` / `history` / `both`):** implemented as a
**pure, non-LLM heuristic function** (`lib/ai/queryClassifier.ts`) — a
regex/keyword matcher (e.g. "earlier", "you said", "previous" → `history`;
legal/contract-term keywords → `contract`; default → `both`). This must not be
a second LLM call: PRD §7 requires the system prompt/context adjustment to
happen "without an extra API call."

**Streaming path:** OpenAI SDK async iterator → Route Handler wraps chunks
into a `ReadableStream` → `new Response(stream, { headers: { 'Content-Type':
'text/event-stream' } })` → client reads via `fetch()` +
`response.body.getReader()` (not `EventSource`, since the request is a POST).
The user message is persisted to `chat_messages` before the OpenAI call
starts; the assistant message is persisted once the stream completes, with
`page_citation` parsed via `/\[Page (\d+)\]/`.

### Cost model

| Call | Est. input tokens | Est. output tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Extraction (20-page contract) | ~15,000 | ~1,500–2,000 | ~$0.10 — within the $0.20 ceiling |
| Chat turn (worst case: full contract + near-200-message history) | up to ~25,000 | ~1,000 | ~$0.14 **per turn** |

> **Open item:** the PRD prices one extraction call ($0.25/analysis ceiling)
> but chat cost compounds per turn with no per-session or per-day cap defined
> anywhere in the PRD. At even 5 chat turns on one contract, chat cost alone
> can approach or exceed the $0.25/analysis budget. A per-user chat-turn
> budget (new, not in the PRD) should be decided before Stage 2 locks the
> schema/rate-limit design — `security-foundation`'s 30 req/min chat rate
> limit bounds abuse, but not sustained legitimate cost.

### Retry / fallback

3 retries with exponential backoff on OpenAI 429/5xx (PRD §3 External
Dependencies), then a human-readable error + "Try again" CTA. State is never
left silently inconsistent: `status='error'` is always set so the user can
retry without re-uploading.

## 9. API Specification

All routes are Next.js Route Handlers under `app/api/`. See §6 for the shared
error contract (401/404/422/429/502).

### Auth

| Method & Path | Purpose | Auth | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/auth/signup` | Email/password sign-up | None | `{ email, password }` | `201` — session cookie set; Supabase sends verification email |
| `POST /api/auth/login` | Email/password login | None | `{ email, password }` | `200` — session cookie set |
| `POST /api/auth/logout` | Sign out | Session | — | `204` |

Password reset uses Supabase's hosted email flow directly from the client —
no custom route needed.

### Contracts — upload & processing

| Method & Path | Purpose | Auth | Request | Response | Validation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/contracts/upload` | Upload PDF, extract text, non-blocking Storage upload | Session | `multipart/form-data`: `file` (PDF), `contract_type` | `201 { contract_id, contract_type, page_count, standard_terms }` | MIME must be `application/pdf`; size ≤10MB; pages ≤20 (via pdf-parse metadata); word count <100 → `status='error'`, `422 SCANNED_PDF_UNSUPPORTED` |
| `POST /api/contracts/:id/custom-terms` | Add a custom term pre-processing | Session + ownership | `{ term_name }` | `201 { id, term_name }` | Max 5/contract → `422 MAX_CUSTOM_TERMS` |
| `DELETE /api/contracts/:id/custom-terms/:termId` | Remove a custom term pre-processing | Session + ownership | — | `204` | `404` if not found/not owned |
| `POST /api/contracts/:id/process` | Trigger GPT-4o extraction | Session + ownership | `{}` (reads custom terms from DB) | `200 { terms: ExtractedTerm[] }` | Contract must be `status IN ('uploaded','error')`; sets `processing` → `completed`/`error` |

### Contracts — read / manage

| Method & Path | Purpose | Auth | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/contracts` | Dashboard list | Session | query: `sort, order, page, pageSize` | `200 { items: ContractSummary[], total }` |
| `GET /api/dashboard/summary` | Dashboard summary cards | Session | — | `200 { total, by_type, recent: ContractSummary[5] }` |
| `GET /api/contracts/:id` | Results page data | Session + ownership | — | `200 { contract, terms, custom_terms, pdf_available }` — bumps `last_accessed_at` |
| `GET /api/contracts/:id/pdf-url` | Refresh signed URL (1hr) | Session + ownership | — | `200 { signed_url, expires_at }` or `404` (triggers text-viewer fallback) |
| `PATCH /api/contracts/:id/terms/:termId` | Inline correction | Session + ownership | `{ value }` | `200 { term }` — ≤2s |
| `DELETE /api/contracts/:id` | Delete contract + cascade | Session + ownership | — | `204` — deletes Storage object then DB row |

### Chat

| Method & Path | Purpose | Auth | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/contracts/:id/chat` | Load chat history on reopen | Session + ownership | — | `200 { session_id, messages }` (ascending, ≤200) |
| `POST /api/contracts/:id/chat` | Send message, stream response | Session + ownership + `status==='completed'` | `{ message }` (≤5000 chars) | `200` streamed `text/event-stream` |

### Feedback

| Method & Path | Purpose | Auth | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/contracts/:id/feedback` | Submit rating + comment | Session + ownership | `{ rating, comment? }` | `200 { feedback }` — upsert on `(contract_id, user_id)` |

### Export (Phase 2 — spec'd now to avoid rework)

| Method & Path | Purpose | Auth | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/contracts/:id/export?format=csv` | CSV of key terms | Session + ownership | `200` file stream, ≤5s |
| `GET /api/contracts/:id/export?format=pdf` | Formatted PDF summary | Session + ownership | `200` file stream, ≤5s |

| Auth (sign up/in/out) | US-001 | Completes ≤10s; redirect to Dashboard; clear error on bad creds | Supabase project + tables |
| PDF upload + text extraction | US-002 | ≤10MB; extraction ≤30s P95 (≤20pg); ≥80% standard terms populated | — |
| Page attribution | US-003 | Each term shows page #; click scrolls viewer | Upload + extraction |
| Confidence score display | US-004 | 0–100% shown; <50% shows warning | Extraction |
| Custom term addition | US-005 | Appear in preview; processed with same structure | Upload |
| Key terms panel | US-011-partial | Shows name/value/page/confidence | Extraction |
| PDF viewer | US-006 | Scroll/zoom; clickable highlighted refs | Storage upload (or text-viewer fallback) |
| Contract chat | US-007 | Response ≤15s; grounded; page-cited | Extraction (contract_text) + chat tables |
| Persistent chat history | US-012 | Reopening loads prior session | Chat |
| Dashboard + history | US-008 | Shows name/type/date/status; row opens results | Contracts table |
| Inline term editing | US-009 | Saves ≤2s; "Edited" badge; original value retained | Extraction |
| Feedback submission | US-010 | Thumbs + comment saved | Contracts table |
| Security audit, WCAG 2.1 AA, rate limiting, onboarding | v1.0 roadmap | — | All above |

## 12. Naming Conventions

| Element | Convention | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Routes/folders | kebab-case | `reset-password/`, `custom-terms/` |
| Components | PascalCase file + export | `KeyTermsPanel.tsx` |
| Hooks | camelCase, `useXxx` | `useChatStream.ts` |
| Lib/service modules | camelCase file, named exports | `extractText.ts` → `extractContractText()` |
| DB tables | snake_case, plural | `extracted_key_terms` |
| DB columns | snake_case | `contract_id`, `confidence_score` |
| Env vars | `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`; `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix only for browser-safe values | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| API route files | fixed Next.js convention | `route.ts` |

## 13. Testing Strategy

| Layer | Framework | Covers | Target |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unit | **Vitest** | `queryClassifier.ts`, `extractText.ts` page-marker logic, Zod schemas, prompt builders | 70% line coverage on `lib/` |
| Integration | **Vitest + local Supabase** (`supabase start`), OpenAI calls mocked with fixed JSON fixtures | Every Route Handler: auth guards, RLS boundary (cross-user read attempt → expect empty/404), validation errors, JSON-parse-retry path | All routes covered |
| E2E | **Playwright** | signup → upload → process → results; inline edit; chat turn (mocked streaming response); grounded vs. "I cannot find this" fallback (hallucination regression check, mocked) | Critical paths green on every deploy |

Vitest is chosen over Jest for faster ESM/TypeScript-native execution in this
stack, with less configuration friction in a Next.js 14 project. Playwright is
the Next.js-recommended E2E tool and handles file-upload simulation and
multi-tab auth flows well.

**Distinct from app testing:** the PRD's 50-contract offline ML evaluation
suite (F1 ≥88%/85%, confidence calibration, page-number accuracy, chat
groundedness expert review) is a separate **`/eval` harness** that runs
against the *real* OpenAI API and real labelled contracts (CUAD + SME-annotated),
on its own cadence (every release / monthly per PRD §10) — it is not part of
`npm test` and must never run on every PR, for cost and flakiness reasons.

## Open Items for Review

These are editorial decisions made to keep the design concrete and complete;
flag any of them for a different call before Stage 2 proceeds.

1. **Feedback (US-010) priority conflict** — story table says P2/Backlog, the
   v1.0 roadmap ships it at launch. This document treats it as Phase 1.
2. **`detected_contract_type` soft-mismatch warning** — only implied under
   Internal Risks, not a numbered FR. Included as a nullable column since it's
   cheap and matches PRD intent; drop if unwanted.
3. **90-day retention sweep has no owning mechanism in the PRD.** Proposing
   Supabase `pg_cron` (DB-native, independent of hosting platform/cron).
4. **Full-account deletion vs. per-contract deletion** — PRD's GDPR language
   implies account-wide deletion; only per-contract delete is an explicit FR.
   A full-account delete endpoint (via Supabase admin API) is recommended but
   not yet specified as a route in §9 — confirm scope before Stage 2.
5. **Netlify function duration** — the 30s P95 extraction budget exceeds
   Netlify's default synchronous Function execution limit (~10s, same class
   of constraint as any serverless host at this budget). Not mentioned
   anywhere in the PRD's pricing section. Two mitigations are documented in
   `docs/engineering/implementation-specs.md` §11 /
   `contractiq/specs/09-infrastructure-deployment.md` (extended-duration
   plan, or restructure as a Background Function) — **still an open
   operational decision to make at actual deploy time**, not yet implemented
   either way.
6. **Chat cost has no per-session/day cap in the PRD** — see §8's cost model;
   multi-turn chat on a single contract can exceed the $0.25/analysis budget,
   which only prices the extraction call.
7. **`README.md`'s mention of "Anthropic Claude API"** is inconsistent with
   the PRD's explicit OpenAI GPT-4o requirement and appears to be stale
   boilerplate — this document follows the PRD (OpenAI).
